notablePrerequisites: Audacious Reshapers does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Audacious Reshapers by tapping it and sacrificing Bottle Golems.
When Bottle Golems dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Bottle Golems trigger, causing you to gain life equal to its power.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bottle Golems on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Audacious Reshapers ability, revealing Bottle Golems from the top of your library, then putting it onto the battlefield and dealing 1 damage to you.
When Bottle Golems enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
